from build123d import *

outer_dia = 38.4
length = 58.7
shoulder_dia = 45.3
shoulder_length = 11.9
extra_length = 9.4
outer_chamfer = 3.5
end_fillet = 2.0

base = Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(outer_dia/2, length)
left_face = base.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[0]
base = fillet(left_face.edges(), end_fillet)

shoulder = Pos(length/2 + shoulder_length/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(shoulder_dia/2, shoulder_length)
combined = base + shoulder

extra = Pos(length/2 + shoulder_length + extra_length/2, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(shoulder_dia/2, extra_length)
combined = combined + extra

right_face = combined.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
combined = chamfer(right_face.edges(), outer_chamfer)

part = combined
part.name = "stepped_shaft"
export_step(part, "output.step")

outer_width = 51.3
outer_depth = 15.0
outer_height = 30.2
flange_depth = 9.9
central_hole_dia = 12.4
mount_hole_dia = 4.2
mount_spacing = 22.5
side_tab_width = 6.7

base = Box(outer_width, outer_depth, outer_height)

result = base + flange
